en.modelSelectorDesc: Checked models will appear in DSH's Antigravity model list.
en.modelSelectorNote: Changes are saved automatically. Reopen the model picker to see the updated list; running sessions are unaffected.
en.noQuotaDesc: No quota data yet. Click Refresh.
en.notSignedInDesc: Click Sign in to complete Google OAuth in your browser. Quotas will appear here after login.
en.pageDesc: Sign in to Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist and view shared quotas.
en.proxyDesc: Route Antigravity login, quota, model, and chat requests through a local HTTP proxy.
en.proxyPortHint: Connects to http://127.0.0.1:{port} (for example, the HTTP port exposed by Clash / mihomo).
en.proxySaved: Proxy settings saved. New requests use them immediately.
